📱💻🎮 Play Anywhere
Supports Console, PC, and Mobile devices.

⭐ Enjoying the game?
Please consider liking and favoriting to help us push more updates!

🖥️ Controls
G — Awakening / Ultimate Mode
F — Block
Q — Dash
Q (while ragdolled) — Ragdoll Cancel / Evasive
Double-Tap W — Sprint
Left Click — Basic Attack
B — Emote Wheel

Some sounds in the game are still missing, we will try to replace them as fast as possible. Thank you!

This experience contains certain assets, such as models, animations, sounds, and visual effects that were created by third-party contributors. All rights and ownership of these assets remain with their original creators.
